practice_observation: Review before the long chains paid for itself: it caught MA1 before the acceptance run, so the suite ran once. The release exposed a CI assumption that held only while no release existed (test ! -e releases); it failed on the first release PR and an independent review of the fix then found the snapshot-timing and symlink issues. Checks that assume an empty state should be written against a before and after comparison. The operator's promote note referred to storm while the scene was the ritual, so the record transcribes the note as written and says which scene it concerns. To improve: the criteria's printed readings are only visible with -s, which cost a second 90 s run.
